spec: OCP ORv3 Rack & Power (Busbar / Power Shelf / BBU)

OCP-ORV3-PWR-001.clause: ORv3 Power §3.2 Internal 48V/50V DC Busbar Voltage Window
OCP-ORV3-PWR-001.title: 机柜内部直流盲插母排电压窗口（48–51 V DC）
OCP-ORV3-PWR-001.quote: ORv3 power shelves regulate the rack-level blind-mate DC bus within the nominal 48 V–51 V DC window (50 V nominal).

OCP-ORV3-PWR-002.clause: ORv3 Power §5.1 Power Shelf N+1 / N+N Redundancy
OCP-ORV3-PWR-002.title: 电源框 N+1 / N+N 冗余供电容量校核
OCP-ORV3-PWR-002.quote: Installed power shelf capacity after deducting at least one redundant shelf (N-1) must equal or exceed nominal rack IT power.

OCP-ORV3-PWR-003.clause: OCP DCF Power §4.2 Busway Voltage Drop & EDPp Provisioning
OCP-ORV3-PWR-003.title: 列顶母线压降限值与峰值功耗（EDPp）馈电裕度
OCP-ORV3-PWR-003.quote: Overhead AC busway voltage drop shall not exceed 2.5% at rated load, and feeder provisioning shall cover rack EDPp peak demand.

OCP-ORV3-PWR-004.clause: ORv3 BBU §3.4 Rack-Level Battery Ride-Through Autonomy
OCP-ORV3-PWR-004.title: 机柜级 BBU 后备穿越续航时间
OCP-ORV3-PWR-004.quote: When ORv3 BBU shelves are deployed for utility-outage ride-through, minimum full-load autonomy shall be >= 90 s to bridge genset sync.
